CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 06 / 14

Shutdown, exit and supply

Shutdown rule停產法則

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply the short-run shutdown rule: shut down when P < AVC at the best operating quantity, or equivalently TR < VC; fixed costs remain payable. At equality, the firm is indifferent under the model.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

短期停產仍要付固定成本。最佳營運方案若 TR<VC，等同該產量 P<AVC，就應停產；臨界相等時兩者無差異。

In the short run, fixed costs remain payable. Shut down if the best operating revenue cannot cover variable cost: TR<VC, or P<AVC at that candidate output. At the threshold, operating and shutdown can give equal profit.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TR=80,VC=100,FC=50. Operating loses 70; shutdown loses 50. Stop production for the period.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

P=4,AVC=5 at the best operating candidate. Short-run decision? 最佳候選產量下價四、AVC 五？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
